column1: NOTE: One row per agent, skill or routine. Fill the white columns (A to K). Columns L to Q are formulas. Formulas below assume data starts on row 8; copy them down.
NOTE: L Monthly time value = C * D. M Total monthly gain = L + E + F + G. N Total monthly cost = H + I + J.
NOTE: O Net monthly gain = M - N. P Payback months = IF(O>0, K / O, "No payback"). Q Annual ROI % = IF((K + N*12)>0, (O*12 - K) / (K + N*12), 0) formatted as percent.
NOTE: Hard gains (cash) go in E and F. Soft gains (time absorbed, not reinvested) should be flagged in column R so they are never mixed with cash in board summaries.
NOTE: Supervision cost (J) = weekly supervision minutes / 60 * hourly cost * 4.33. Use the Cost per Agent worksheet to calculate H, I and J.
NOTE: Example rows are illustrative. Replace them with your own numbers. Be conservative: round gains down and costs up.
